operations.title: Grothendieck makes the kernel quotient and invariant quotient formally separate
operations.body: Accepted and integrated. The theorem now states two distinct universal properties: q:G->G/K_phys is the smallest representation-kernel quotient killing jointly invisible commutators and answers which transformations remain visible; pi:V->Spec A[V]^G is universal among G-invariant affine maps and answers which scalar records distinguish physical orbits. The latter is neither group abelianization nor determined by the former without extra typed hypotheses. The exact result pins the D3 control Q[a,b]^D3=Q[q2,q3] and bounded orbit separation. This completes the scope refinement while preserving the physical commutator detector, the six-point untyped gate, and the Phase-II prohibition.

authority_basis.summary: Operator directed marici.Grothendieck to read new epistemic messages and continue.
